Curation history
2026-10-11T00:42:35Z codex
CREATE — Add the complete two-step CurA curcumin degradation pathway

Created exact GO:0036040 with both native CurA reductions and the dihydrocurcumin intermediate, supported homodimer membership, NADPH cosubstrate role and explicitly computational localization. Preserved K-12 DH10B versus recombinant BL21 experimental scope and excluded redundant net reaction, downstream mineralization, invented transport and metal requirements. Reassessed the prior single-enzyme exclusion: this record denotes the complete source-defined two-reaction pathway. Author replay verified both reaction sides, balances, all identifiers, source hashes and local schemas. Evidence is in research/pathway_additions/2026-10-10-next-routes/curcumin-curation.md and curcumin-validation.json. Independent scientific review and final corpus gates follow before publication.

Read this curation session

EDIT — Add 1 native monomer/CDS -> UniProtKB protein unification mapping(s) in source_mappings for GO:0036040

Added 1 explicit SSSOM protein unification mapping(s) in source_mappings (MetaCyc:G6760-MONOMER -> UniProtKB:P76113) linking native monomer protein / CDS reference(s) to their 1:1 UniProtKB protein participant(s) backed by edge-level dblink/sequence unification evidence.
